name: 78723 · Austin, TX
findings: ZIP 78723 (Austin) has 166 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 67 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78723 (Austin) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
